review:
The Kraken returns on a bigger 5x4 grid, with random base-game features – wild respins, shifting stacked wilds and spins that always produce a payout – keeping things busy.

The bonus brings a growing multiplier and a gamble: risk your award for more spins, but a failed gamble can end the extras. A real decision. The 5,000x max is lower than the original's. 96.5% RTP. Test the gamble in demo first.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
